Is Monaco’s Grace Kelly 2 euro coin really that valuable?

24 November 20262 min read

Short answer

Yes. An uncirculated Grace Kelly coin from 2007 in its case is valued at about €2,300 to €3,359. Monaco never officially put it into circulation.

In this article

  1. Look for the date and the engraver’s name
  2. Read the price alongside the description
  3. Check the piece itself
  4. Check it yourself

You open an old coin box and see a woman’s profile beside the word MONACO on a 2 euro coin. If it is a genuine 2007 Grace Kelly in its original case, it can indeed be worth thousands. The collector range for the uncirculated issue is around €2,300 to €3,359.

An old collection is a more plausible place to see one than a handful of change. Monaco sold it only in brilliant uncirculated condition, known as BU, in a case. It never officially entered circulation. There are also counterfeit coins and look-alike medals, so take a close look at the piece itself as well as the picture on it.

Look for the date and the engraver’s name

Princess Grace faces left. MONACO and 2007 curve around the portrait at the bottom right, and the name R.B. BARON appears on the design. Check those details together when you compare the piece to a picture. Monaco appears on other coins too, so the date and portrait narrow down what you have.

The official mintage is 20,000. Some accounts give 20,001 because, according to HelloMonaco, there was an extra example for Prince Albert. For the practical job of identifying the issue, write down the year and the lettering you can actually see.

Read the price alongside the description

A specimen in a damaged case fetched €2,300 at CGB on 30 June 2026. The buyer’s fee was another 18 percent. The auction gives a price for a particular coin with a described case, and the fee tells you what a buyer had to pay on top of the hammer price.

NumisCorner sold a loose example graded MS60-62 for €1,450. The date of that sale is unknown. It gives you one example of a sale without a box, for a coin with a specific grade. For a worn Grace Kelly, there is no confirmed collector price to use as a benchmark.

Check the piece itself

The Bundesbank knows of counterfeits that carry no COPY mark. Weight and colour are worth checking if you have a possible match. If a case turned up with the coin, keep the two together for comparison with a sale description. The portrait and lettering can help you identify the issue. A physical examination is needed to settle authenticity, especially if you plan to buy or sell the coin.

Monaco officially put the 2007 Grace Kelly coin into circulation.

Show the answer

False. It was issued to collectors in brilliant uncirculated condition in a case.
